method_notes: Authority per project rule: venueid must be <Conf>.cc/<Year>/... AND a Camera_Ready_Revision invitation must exist. Submission/Withdrawn/Rejected venueid = not accepted.

OpenReview 'notes?forum=<id>' and 'notes?id=<id>' are behind a bot challenge from this network (HTTP 403 ChallengeRequiredError, reqId 2026-08-14-5411245). 'notes/search?query=' works and returns the full content dict including _bibtex, so all fields below were read from the search endpoint.

DBLP-mirrored OpenReview records (venueid = dblp.org/conf/... or dblp.org/journals/CORR/...) were explicitly EXCLUDED as authority; they exist for 4 of the 6 papers and reading them alone would produce a false 'preprint' verdict.

Semantic Scholar was NOT used as a judgement basis (and was returning HTTP 429 anyway). Per project rule S2/DBLP lag on 2026 venues — confirmed again here: DBLP has ZERO record for cho2026choices and lists oostermeijer2026length as 'CoRR 2026' only, while both are OpenReview-confirmed accepted with Camera_Ready_Revision.
decoration was read from the OpenReview 'venue' string, which for these venues carries the decoration token (e.g. 'ICLR 2025 Oral', 'ICLR 2024 spotlight', 'ICLR 2026 Poster', 'NeurIPS 2021 Poster').
GPU usage: zero. No SSH to any compute node. Network + local file reads only.

entries.doi_checked: No DOI in the bib entry and none required — NeurIPS proceedings papers of this era carry no Crossref DOI. Identity is pinned instead by the official proceedings hash URL and DBLP key (both verified below).
entries.notes: ACCEPTANCE VERIFIED, but note the camera-ready criterion cannot apply here and its 'false' value must NOT be read as a failure. In 2021 OpenReview used the single-invitation model: this note's invitation is 'NeurIPS.cc/2021/Conference/-/Blind_Submission' and per-submission Camera_Ready_Revision invitations did not exist yet, so has_camera_ready_revision is structurally unavailable for ALL NeurIPS 2021 papers. Acceptance is instead proven three independent ways: (1) OpenReview venueid = NeurIPS.cc/2021/Conference with venue = 'NeurIPS 2021 Poster' (decoration = Poster, matching the bib) and a non-null pdate (1636492709113 = 2021-11-09) which OpenReview only sets on acceptance; (2) DBLP conf/nips/DingDS21, booktitle 'Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34', pages 1556--1568 — EXACTLY the pages claimed in refs.bib, so the page range is verified; (3) the official proceedings page proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/0c0bf917c7942b5a08df71f9da626f97 returns HTTP 200 with <title> 'Grounding Representation Similarity Through Statistical Testing' and 'Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (NeurIPS 2021)'. Authors 3/3 exact. API1 (api.openreview.net) was required — API2 returns nothing relevant for this pre-2023 venue. TITLE TRAP CONFIRMED STILL HANDLED CORRECTLY: refs.bib says 'Through', which matches the camera-ready in all three authorities; the arXiv:2108.01661 record says 'with'. Keep 'Through'. Two DBLP-mirrored OpenReview decoys exist for this paper (FifdmcZVOV venueid dblp.org/conf/NIPS/2021, and Sov1eh9hYog venueid dblp.org/journals/CORR/2021 which carries the WRONG 'with' title) — neither is authority.

rules_revalidated_by_this_run: S2/DBLP lag on 2026 venues is REAL and was reproduced: cho2026choices has ZERO DBLP records despite being an accepted ICLR 2026 Poster with Camera_Ready_Revision; oostermeijer2026length appears in DBLP only as 'CoRR 2026'. Routing either through DBLP/S2 would have produced a false preprint verdict.
DBLP-mirrored OpenReview notes are a live trap: 4 of 6 papers have such mirrors, and Ding's CoRR mirror even carries a different (arXiv) title. Filter on venueid starting with '<Conf>.cc/'.

The Camera_Ready_Revision criterion is anachronistic for pre-2022 OpenReview venues (single Blind_Submission invitation era). For those, acceptance must be established via venueid + non-null pdate + official proceedings, as done for ding2021grounding. Applying the criterion blindly would have failed a genuine NeurIPS 2021 poster.
Workshop-vs-conference collision is live: zheng2025cheating also has a NeurIPS 2024 SafeGenAi workshop record for the same title.
